title: Repair truthful causal completeness for Paper rejection and no-trade journeys

candidate_f6_failure_evidence.failure_message: Trade Journey was not formal complete truth

after_restore_e9_readback_diagnosis.why_risk_evaluation_was_missing: paper_runtime.py emitted a separate risk_evaluation telemetry event only for committed_fill and canonical_lifecycle, while pre-broker order_rejection (sell_without_holdings) and explicit no-trade paper_order_simulated mapped directly to order_submission (index 9 of STAGES). Because risk_evaluation (index 8 of STAGES) is an observable stage before order_submission, JourneyMaterializer._missing_stages and TradeJourneyProjectionStore._projection_from_journey included risk_evaluation in completeness.missing_stages, causing trade_journeys._read_state to downgrade both detail and list surfaces from formal to partial.

repair_summary.paper_runtime: Stamps truthful risk_status=rejected and risk_decision_id on pre-broker order_rejection events (including sell_without_holdings) and risk_status=skipped on explicit no-trade paper_order_simulated events without fabricating fills, cash/position mutations, or extra telemetry events.
repair_summary.lifecycle_projector: Propagates explicit pre-broker rejection (risk_status=rejected, reason_code, submitted_to_broker=false) and explicit no-trade (risk_status=skipped, decision_status=no_order, order_status=not_submitted, reason_code) contract fields while stripping post-decision order/fill/ledger/reconciliation identifiers.
repair_summary.materializer: Records truthful risk_evaluation stage coverage (rejected for evaluated pre-broker order rejections, skipped for explicit no-order skips) only when required upstream signal_generation and trade_decision stages are present, no post-submission stages or fill/ledger/reconciliation identifiers exist, and explicit terminal non-fill evidence is present; rolls up explicit trade_decision skipped without order_submission as no_order.
repair_summary.bff_trade_journeys: Normalizes non-fill terminal stage coverage and completeness across detail, list, timeline, graph, and evidence surfaces (including already-persisted journeys rows) while keeping incomplete/missing upstream decisions or unverified/broker-submitted order failures partial, anomalies degraded, and unavailable readers unavailable.
